segments.contextAfter: QAGS is globally adaptive and permits infinite bounds on the integration interval. Within each subinterval it uses 21 points if both bounds are finite, or 15 if one or both bounds are infinite. The algorithm is accelerated by Peter Wynn’s epsilon algorithm. If at least one of the interval bounds is infinite, this is equivalent to the QUADPACK QAGI routine. Otherwise, this is equivalent to the QUADPACK QAGS routine.
